eps_note: loss is 1 - score; unconfirmed or group-targeting studies score 0, confirmed studies score 0.25 + 0.75 * committee score (or 1 in explicit gate-only mode, IGNOBEL_COMMITTEE=off)

directives.EXPLOIT: Stay in your field; pick a sharper prediction from the same literature on a different real dataset (each dataset gets one test per run) and predict the effect size you expect.
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Switch field and change the idea, not just the label: new variables and a new dataset. Use Exa to read real papers and past Ig Nobel winners in a field nobody has tried, then pre-register a surprising prediction that could fail on a public CSV/TSV the papers or data portals point to.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Pick a study type nobody has used (resolve two conflicting published findings, or test a published effect in a new population), combine it with another agent's surprising variable, and find a dataset that can answer it.
directives.CONVERGED: Re-register the best finding's mechanism on an independent real dataset to check that it holds elsewhere.

peer_directive: Build on a colleague: {peer} last tried "{idea}". Cross it with your own field, test the strangest consequence that could prove it wrong, or carry its surprising variable to a new dataset. Do not re-test their variables or dataset.
